ev.q: In 2010, a total of 15,323 deaths among women were attributed to drug overdose, a rate of 9.8 per 100,000 population.
The percentage increase in number of OPR overdose deaths was 415% for women and 265% for men.

One or more prescription drugs were involved in 9,292 (85%) of the drug-specified deaths among women
Age-adjusted drug overdose death rates ranged from 3.9 per 100,000 women in North Dakota to 18.5 in Nevada.
The all drug rate for men was 1.35 times the rate for women in 2010
